text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Premium photorealistic wardrobe catalog asset. Portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric and metal texture, subtle contact shadows, whole object uncropped with generous margin. No captions, price labels, watermarks, surroundings or people. Garments: Oversized black long-sleeve lace-up football jersey with royal-blue rectangular chest panel and large white cursive lettering, faded blue distressed knee-length denim Bermuda shorts with white tribal side print and torn knees; tall black lace-up canvas boots with wide folded eyelet cuffs and thick white platform soles. Show one front-facing assembled outfit using hollow invisible-mannequin display, natural volume but absolutely no body, skin, head, hands, legs, visible mannequin or stand. Exclude ALL detachable accessories: bags, hats, eyeglasses, belts, watches, jewelry and handheld props. Integral garment trims remain. Show hollow inner neck and cuffs.
